name: Thijs Reuten, Nina Carberry - Après le considérant J - Am 1
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement
part_text: 36. Welcomes the UK Government’s decision to reset its relationship with the EU and expresses its satisfaction at the fact that citizens’ safety remains pivotal under this new approach; reiterates the importance of the continued full implementation of existing UK-EU agreements, including the Good Friday Agreement and the Windsor Framework; welcomes the boost provided by the Joint Statement and Common Understanding on a renewed agenda for EU-UK cooperation, adopted by the UK and the Commission at the first EU-UK summit on 19 May 2025, in terms of enhanced law enforcement and judicial cooperation in criminal matters, strengthened cooperation in relation to drugs risks and threats, and deepened cooperation on challenges posed by irregular migration;
